independent_DFL.validation_scope: No-tag per-frame official provider flags; not Metrica references, challenge truth, or independent Smart Tagging validation.

release_blockers: Inherited active semi-Markov, restart-localization, restart-ownership and prediction-window origins are not independently reselected or clarified.
Forty-four other configured inherited keys are not fully traced in this release audit; verified geometry/kinematics are listed separately in the detailed local report.
DFL has no challenge Smart Tagging; tagged-input semantics/timing are not independently transferred.
DFL independent gains are positive but much smaller than the Metrica provider-reference gains; challenge accuracy is unknown.
limitations: Fresh DFL validation J03WN1 was first evaluated after candidate config/parser freeze and was not used for retuning; the other DFL match developed the adapter.
DFL frame-level flags are provider annotations with different tracking conventions, not official challenge possession truth.
Licensed challenge match assets, model caches and detector weights are not shared in the repository.
The candidate differs from the selected output but must not be presented as a proven challenge-score gain.
